ratio: recorded prompt_tokens / in_upper, over records with prompt_tokens > 0
adjusted_ratio: recorded prompt_tokens / (in_upper + prompt_overhead_tokens(model)), over records with prompt_tokens > 0
anomaly_rule: prompt_tokens above 3 times the median prompt_tokens of the other models on the same item
labels: in_upper is the router's upper bound on prompt tokens, computed from the prompt bytes
prompt_tokens are the counts recorded in the dataset; nothing here is simulated
prompt_overhead_tokens are fitted on train and calib records only, so the test and heldout rows are an out-of-sample check
